lines.text: Two threads add one million times each. The total should be two million.
Both add to the same counter, in a loop of a million. In one version I protect nothing. In the other two, I use a mutex and atomic.
Without protection, the total went from close to a million to over one million three hundred thousand, and changed every run. With the mutex, two million, in all fifteen.
Without protection, eleven milliseconds, and wrong. With the mutex, ninety-two, and right. With atomic, twenty-one, and right.
Why does the total come up short without the mutex? Comment below. Code in the description.
